title: ChineseEEG: A Chinese Linguistic Corpora EEG Dataset for Semantic Alignment and Neural Decoding
description: ChineseEEG is a high-density EEG dataset with simultaneous eye-tracking recorded from 10 participants who silently read two Chinese children's novels (The Little Prince and Garnett Dream), with about 11 hours of reading per participant in total. It includes raw data, filtered and minimally pre-processed EEG derivatives, and BERT-base-chinese text embeddings of the stimulus materials. The resource supports research on semantic alignment between language model representations and neural activity, and on neural decoding.
methods_description: Participants read text presented as three-line pages, with the middle line highlighted. Each character was highlighted in red for 0.35 s. High-density EEG was recorded with an EGI system at 1 kHz alongside eye-tracking, with eye-tracker calibration at the start of each run. Triggers marked chapters, rows and calibration events. Data were converted to BrainVision format in EEG-BIDS using MNE-BIDS. Filtered (0.5-80 Hz and 0.5-30 Hz) and pre-processed derivatives at 256 Hz are provided.
